page_subtitle: Paste a posting and score it against your resume in a few seconds.
job_posting_placeholder: Paste the full job posting text here...
extra_info_placeholder: Anything not covered by the posting - a referral, a conversation with the recruiter...
blockers_hint: Hard dealbreakers. If a posting matches any of these, it's scored 0 automatically — no exceptions. Write them in the first person, e.g. "I only want fully remote positions" or "I don't want unpaid internships".
factors_hint: Softer signals that push the score up or down, but never to zero. Weight 1 = minor nudge, 3 = major. E.g. "salary above $120k" (plus) or "requires on-call rotation" (minus).
error_no_resume: Add a resume before evaluating — it's required to score anything.
warning_missing_context_prefix: For a sharper evaluation, consider adding:
manual_assist_hint: Runs automatically right after a job you evaluate here reaches the score threshold below - resume changes are auto-applied, and any base questions get an application pre-filled with drafted answers.
manual_assist_min_score_tooltip: Only jobs scoring at or above this run the tailoring and questions below automatically.
manual_assist_tailoring_tooltip: Your resume can be tailored to match a posting. Toggle which kinds of edits get applied automatically once a job reaches the score above.
manual_assist_questions_tooltip: Every question here is answered automatically for every passing job, using your resume and this posting - saved as a draft application you can review afterwards.
manual_assist_questions_example: e.g. "Write a cover letter" or "Why do you want to work here?"
manual_assist_question_placeholder: e.g. Describe a project you're proud of
manual_assist_no_questions: No base questions yet - applications won't be pre-answered.
level_soft_tooltip: Terminology-only edits - rewording your title, job titles, and reordering/selecting skills you already list. Nothing is invented or rewritten in substance.
level_medium_tooltip: Light rewrites of your summary and experience bullets to weave in the posting's keywords. Still grounded only in what's already on your resume.
change_type_title_tooltip: Changes the main headline under your name (e.g. your title/specialization).
change_type_company_name_tooltip: Only reworks how a role's job title is phrased under an experience entry - not the company name, not the main headline.
change_type_skills_tooltip: Reorders and rephrases the skills list, using only skills already present in your resume.
change_type_summary_tooltip: Rewrites the summary paragraph to foreground experience relevant to this posting.
change_type_bullet_tooltip: Targeted edits to experience bullets/paragraphs, weaving in the posting's keywords without inventing anything.
